acceptanceCriteria: The target proposal is human-reviewable, links this handoff and both baselines, and contains no unrelated contract change.
avmRequirements: Run the target repository formatting, lint, documentation, examples, test, and AVM pattern-module compliance checks.
compatibilityConstraints: Preserve existing Terraform inputs and outputs; use a reviewed deprecation transition before any removal.
defaultBehavior: Preserve existing Terraform defaults unless a documented migration and semantic-version decision explicitly changes them.
Terraform standalone GenAI storage defaults GRS with shared access keys enabled; Foundry BYOR storage defaults ZRS with shared access keys disabled.

standalone-network-isolated: Require a separate successful approved test deployment plus reviewed DNS, endpoint, reachability, RBAC, and isolation comparison for this scenario.
standalone-standard: Static checks and plan are non-parity evidence; require a successful approved test deployment and reviewed capability comparison for this scenario.

exclusions: Do not implement hub-spoke or arbitrary optional-feature combinations in this proposal unless separately reviewed.
identityRequirements: Prefer managed identity; preserve inventory identity behavior and do not introduce credentials.
Bicep centralizes control-plane and Cosmos data-plane assignments and avoids runtime account keys by default where supported.
Existing connection strings are secure inputs and are not emitted in inventory or outputs.
Search and Speech identities and deploying principal receive explicit data-plane roles in Bicep.
migrationPlan: No consumer migration is intended; reject implementation choices that require one and return for review.
networkingRequirements: Preserve scenario-specific public access, private endpoint, DNS, route, subnet, delegation, and dependency-ordering behavior recorded by the inventory.
Bicep optionally deploys AMPLS and monitor/opinsights/automation DNS zones only in isolated local-workspace deployments.
Public access and IP rules follow networkIsolation/allowedIpRanges; isolated services receive private endpoints.
Speech and Search use disabled public access plus private endpoints when isolated.

owner.source: AI Landing Zone data and AI maintainers; AI Landing Zone observability maintainers

rbacRequirements: Apply least-privilege RBAC and preserve explicit control-plane and data-plane role boundaries.
Bicep centralizes control-plane and Cosmos data-plane assignments and avoids runtime account keys by default where supported.
Existing connection strings are secure inputs and are not emitted in inventory or outputs.
Search and Speech identities and deploying principal receive explicit data-plane roles in Bicep.
requiredBehavior: Cosmos DB, Storage, Key Vault, and containers: Feature flags, existing Key Vault, Cosmos database/throughput/analytical storage, and Storage/Cosmos container lists.
Log Analytics, Application Insights, and AMPLS: Create/reuse observability resources, secure existing connection string, mixed-workspace guard, private AMPLS, IDs, and runtime telemetry values.
AI Search, Bing grounding, and Speech: Feature flags, region overrides, Speech SKU allowed values, connections, endpoints, names, regions, and resource IDs.

standalone-network-isolated: search-bing-speech-services: partial - Search and grounding constructs are sparse and no equivalent standalone Speech service/output contract was found.
data-services-contract: partial - Core accounts exist, but database/container shaping, runtime keys, and automatic data-plane RBAC differ.
observability-log-analytics-app-insights: absent - No Application Insights/AMPLS equivalent was found; Terraform exposes only the Container Apps Environment Log Analytics dependency.
standalone-standard: search-bing-speech-services: blocked - Terraform cannot offer these services in Bicep's public no-VNet baseline. Terraform service topology depends on required VNet/private endpoints and mostly disabled public access, preventing standalone-standard.

data-services-contract: blocked - Terraform service defaults disable public access and require private endpoints. Terraform GenAI Storage, Cosmos, and Key Vault default to disabled public access and private endpoints in the mandatory VNet, preventing standalone-standard.

observability-log-analytics-app-insights: blocked - Terraform cannot deploy the public standard landing-zone topology. Terraform observability remains part of a mandatory private landing-zone topology, so it cannot represent standalone-standard.

securityInvariants: Do not store secrets, private environment values, or claim effective isolation from static inspection.
